Name: Joja Cola Changes Your Life
Author: APD41
Description:
游戏版本是1.6以上的请去“FILES”分区下载为1.6更新的版本。

If your game version is 1.6 or later, please go to the "FILES" and download the file  updated for 1.6 version.


从现在开始Joja可乐能恢复高达223的能量和100的血量，并且能提供3点耕种3点运气2点速度的长达十多个小时的增益，然而Joja可乐的售价仍不变，保持75g（因为我不会改（笑））。

From now on Joja Cola can restore your energy up to 223, HP up to 100, besides, it gives you buffs that lasts more than 10 hours: 3 farming, 3 luck and 2 speed. The price of Joja Cola is still 75g(because I dong't get how to change it :p).

需要SMAPI和Content Patcher

This mod requires SMAPI and Content Patcher.

Downloads.Description:
Joja可乐被加强，它现在可以恢复许多能量和生命值并且提供了很长时间的三种重要增益。
This mod gives Joja Cola a super buff so that the farmer who drinks it is able to restore many energy and HP, with a long-lasting 3 kind of buffs.
